companies.name: クレイトン・デュビリア・アンド・ライス

relations.text: 2022年11月に産業事業の過半の持ち分を売却した相手である
relations.text_en: Roper divested a majority equity stake in its industrial businesses to CD&R in November 2022

source.label: Roper Technologies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In November 2022, Roper completed the divestiture of a majority equity stake in its industrial businesses, including its entire historical Process Technologies reportable segment and the industrial businesses within its historical Measurement & Analytical Solutions reportable segment (collectively “Indicor”), to Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, LLC (“CD&R”).

relations.text: 売却後も少数株主として持ち分を保有している
relations.text_en: Roper retained a minority equity interest in Indicor after the sale

source.label: Roper Technologies 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Following the sale of the majority stake, Roper retained a minority equity interest in Indicor.
